mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase by > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO annual > 0.5%) indicates expanding economic output, supporting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annual growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220) preserves real interest rate stability, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 220.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS MoM > 0.5%) reflects a healthy labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS MoM growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 570) combined with robust GDP growth (GDPC1 > 12900) indicates a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 570 and GDPC1 exceeds 12900.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO annual < 0.0%) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO annual growth is below 0.0%.
